rubric_items.reason: All 18 known REQs are traced by at least one story; no assumed or unknown REQs exist.
Stories are mostly single-outcome; S-4 still bundles placement, privacy and page exclusivity, and S-3 bundles counts with the warning.
F-1 resolved: S-6 uses a non-default zone (UTC) so a hard-coded Asia/Kolkata fails. Remaining gaps: S-4 privacy ACs seed only part of the contact and medical history fields.
Threshold 2, empty-state texts and UTC+05:30 come from the intent or are derived inline; S-6 expected values are derived inline from the UTC instants.
Readable with consistent terms; body ACs for S-2 to S-5 remain abbreviated and drop the Given/When/Then form used in the front matter.
